title: The Hunger Games
blurb: A dazzling televised spectacle, darling, where one girl's instincts transform survival into the most unforgettable performance Panem has ever applauded. Expect suspense, alliances, and a finale with impeccable dramatic timing.

title: Catching Fire
blurb: The victory tour glitters beautifully until the districts begin telling their own story. A second engagement with the Games brings heightened stakes, sharper silhouettes, and absolutely no shortage of spectacle.

title: Mockingjay
blurb: A symbol is selected, polished, and placed in the spotlight as rebellion becomes Panem's most provocative production. It is a grand finale about image, power, and the price of a perfect public performance.

title: The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes
blurb: Travel back to the Games' earliest, most experimental season, when a young mentor discovers how charisma can turn a rough production into must-see television. Ambition has never looked so polished—or so perilous.

title: Sunrise on the Reaping
blurb: A new reaping dawns over a nation that has mastered the art of calling fear entertainment. Haymitch Abernathy enters the arena with wit, grit, and a remarkably compelling refusal to follow the program.
